name: team
description: Orchestrates specialized agents to autonomously implement entire features end-to-end

interface.shortDescription: Autonomous feature pipeline: question, research, design, plan, implement, review, PR.
interface.longDescription: Team turns a feature description into a reviewed pull request. It walks a ten-phase pipeline — worktree, question, research, design, structure, plan, implement, review, security, PR — dispatching a specialist agent at each phase and persisting every artifact to disk. An adversarial design review gates the design, four reviewers gate the implementation in the review phase, and a security reviewer gates it in the security phase, so the only human checkpoint is the pull request at the end.
defaultPrompt: Run the Team pipeline on this feature.
Fix this bug with the Team bug-fix pipeline.
Draft a reviewed design for this change.
